description: Our on-chain game programs on X1 and their status. Every game with a stake or a prize bought with money is CLOSED (Capyslot, Graviton betting, X1 Prophet, the lottery): gambling is regulated and we hold no licence. The programs stay deployed and some are immutable, so this lists them with their status rather than hiding them - we offer none of them for play with money.
name: onchain_games
